caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass candlestick placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The candlestick has a broad, flat base with softly curved edges that transitions into a hexagonal, faceted stem. The stem narrows upward and then flares out again into a wide, round drip tray below a cylindrical candle holder with a slightly widened rim. The shading is done in grayscale tones, indicating reflections and the transparent nature of the material. Subtle, darker lines and shading delineate the contours and reflections on the glass, enhancing the sense of depth and clarity in the object. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the image.
